MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable felt relevant because my DVI cable purchase suggests an interest in connecting displays, although I would need to confirm that my equipment uses HDMI.",
    "The router connected with my interest in networking, reflected in my WiFi and Ethernet adapters, but that interest alone does not mean I need a router upgrade."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and Fire TV devices serve voice-assistant and entertainment needs that my computer-accessory purchases do not suggest.",
    "Buying a tablet mount does not mean I want another tablet; the mount serves equipment I may already have.",
    "The hard drives and memory card offer storage, while my recent purchases address connections and ports. Sharing USB compatibility does not make them useful for the same purpose."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat an interest in electronics as interest in many different electronic devices, regardless of what I would use them for.",
    "The list seems to put too much weight on widely purchased products when their purpose has little connection to my history."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases mostly involve practical accessories that connect or support existing equipment, rather than replacements or new entertainment devices.",
    "The exact connection matters: a DVI cable does not establish an HDMI need, and an Ethernet adapter does not establish a router problem.",
    "My interactions are infrequent, and I would usually skip even a related accessory unless it solves a specific current need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my connectivity interests but stretched them into broader device and storage needs that I have not expressed."
}
